content: Other specialized reports focus on slightly different market segments, forecasting global steel fabrication growth from USD 21.34 billion in 2024 to USD 30.51 billion by 2035, with a more conservative compound annual growth rate of 3.30 percent . The momentum of the structural fabrications market is further supported by short-term and medium-term growth metrics. Global and North American forecasts for metal fabrication indicate a projected 5.5 percent growth for 2026, following a 2.19 percent increase in 2025 . Furthermore, future trends for the broader global structural steel fabrication market suggest a potential compound annual growth rate of 10.3 percent from 2024 to 2030 [12] . Despite these strong global indicators, the existing literature fails to deliver regionally specific or historical data for the South African structural fabrications segment during the specified timeframes . The lack of regionally targeted sources highlights the inherent difficulty in synthesizing coherent, actionable insights for the local market based solely on international macro-analyses [12] .
